Welcome to our life of organized chaos! You never know what a day holds here in the Ozark mountains.  Between having 14 children (and 7 bonus kids through marriages), plus the daily craziness of farm life, and all that topped off with the unpredictability of wildlife rehab and rescue, there is always something happening around here! God has truly blessed us with daily opportunities to care for and enjoy HIS creatures, and we'd love to share a bit of our lives with you. Please join us and subscribe!

Aaron, Lori, and all the kids 

Philippians 2:14-15
